title: The Mirror Wheel and the Nested Circuits
description: How nothing the self organizes can hide. T36 — the wheel before the King of Glory: a great mirror set before the Lord's gate, in which every motion of self-love at every degree is held transparent, with twelve marks of fixity sealing every faculty. T37 — the three zones nested within one another: the self in five aspects fettered inside the five degrees of the rational, all suspended from the rational operating upward in regeneration, beneath the firmament that keeps the orders distinct. The deeper captivity is not concealable; it is set inside the very structure that will lift it.
